explanation.question_quote: The chest pain occurs after climbing more than 2 flight of stairs or walking for more than 10 minutes and resolves with rest.
explanation.sentence: His chest pain comes on predictably with climbing stairs or prolonged walking and resolves with rest.
This is the classic pattern of stable angina, in which myocardial oxygen demand rises during exertion and exceeds the blood supply available through a narrowed coronary artery.
A fixed atherosclerotic stenosis greater than 70% is the best explanation because it can limit blood flow during exertion while still allowing adequate perfusion at rest.

Coronary vasospasm typically causes pain unrelated to exertion, while acute coronary thrombosis is more consistent with an unstable or infarction presentation than with predictable effort-related pain.
